## plugin:figma:figma
The official Figma MCP server. Use this server whenever the user wants to create, generate, edit, implement, or sync any design, UI, screen, component, mockup, or visual — in Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or Figma Slides — and whenever the user mentions Figma or provides a figma.com URL.

This server bridges code and design in both directions, and supports designing from scratch using existing design systems and codebases.

CAPABILITIES:
- Read designs FROM Figma into code (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Write designs INTO Figma from code, intent, or existing components (use_figma, generate_figma_design, create_new_file, upload_assets)
- Bridge code and design via Code Connect (get_code_connect_map, add_code_connect_map)
- Create diagrams and FigJam content (generate_diagram, get_figjam)

WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user wants to create, mock up, or generate any UI, screen, component, or design — even if Figma isn't named
- The user wants to implement a design as code (design-to-code)
- The user wants to push a page, view, or component into Figma (code-to-design)
- The user wants to update, sync, or edit an existing Figma file
- The user shares a figma.com URL
- The user wants to build or extend a design system, design tokens, or component library
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

- /figma-use — MANDATORY before calling use_figma; fallback: skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md

- /figma-generate-library — for building a design system in Figma from code; fallback: skill://figma/figma-generate-library/SKILL.md
- /figma-code-connect — for mapping Figma components to codebase components; fallback: skill://figma/figma-code-connect/SKILL.md

- figma:figma-code-connect: Creates and maintains Figma Code Connect template files that map Figma components to code snippets. Use when the user mentions Code Connect, Figma component mapping, design-to-code translation, or asks to create/update .figma.ts or .figma.js files.
- figma:figma-create-new-file: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `create_new_file` tool call. NEVER call `create_new_file` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user wants a new blank Figma file — a new design, FigJam, or Slides file — or when you need a fresh file before calling `use_figma`. Usage — /figma-create-new-file [editorType] [fileName] (e.g. /figma-create-new-file figjam My Whiteboard, /figma-create-new-file slides Q3 Review)
- figma:figma-design-to-code: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE calling the `get_design_context` Figma MCP tool. You MUST trigger this skill whenever the user wants to implement, build, port, or code up a Figma design as code. Example prompts (not exhaustive) are 'implement this Figma design', 'build this screen from Figma', 'turn this Figma into code', 'design to code'. This skill provides critical instructions and steps to the agent on how to correctly implement Figma designs in code and must NOT be skipped.
- figma:figma-generate-design: Use this skill alongside figma-use when the task involves translating an application page, view, or multi-section layout into Figma. Triggers: 'write to Figma', 'create in Figma from code', 'push page to Figma', 'take this app/page and build it in Figma', 'create a screen', 'build a landing page in Figma', 'update the Figma screen to match code', 'convert this modal/dialog/drawer/panel to Figma'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, modal, dialog, drawer, sidebar, panel, or any composed multi-section view in Figma from code or a description. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles from Code Connect files, existing screens, and library search, then imports them and assembles views incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.
- figma:figma-generate-diagram: MANDATORY prerequisite — load this skill BEFORE every `generate_diagram` tool call. NEVER call `generate_diagram` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user asks to create, generate, draw, render, sketch, or build a diagram — flowchart, architecture diagram, sequence diagram, ERD or entity-relationship diagram, state diagram or state machine, gantt chart, or timeline. Also trigger when the user mentions Mermaid syntax or wants a system architecture, decision tree, dependency graph, API call flow, auth handshake, schema, or pipeline visualized in FigJam. Routes to type-specific guidance, sets universal Mermaid constraints, and tells you when to use a different diagram type or skip the tool entirely (mindmaps, pie charts, class diagrams, etc.).
- figma:figma-generate-library: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, create individual components with proper variant sets and variable bindings, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
- figma:figma-implement-motion: Translates Figma motion and animations into production-ready application code. Use when implementing animation/motion from a Figma design — user mentions "implement this motion", "add animation from Figma", "animate this component", provides a Figma URL whose node is animated, or when `get_design_context` returns motion data or instructs you to call `get_motion_context`.
- figma:figma-swiftui: SwiftUI ↔ Figma translation. Use whenever the user mentions Swift, SwiftUI, iOS, iPhone, or iPad — in EITHER direction — translating a Figma design into SwiftUI (design → code), or pushing SwiftUI views / screens / tokens back into a Figma file (code → design). Triggers on phrases like 'implement this Figma design in SwiftUI', 'build this screen in Swift', 'push this SwiftUI view to Figma', 'mirror my Swift code in a Figma file', or whenever a Figma URL appears alongside `.swift` files / an `.xcodeproj`. Routes to a direction-specific reference doc; loads alongside `figma-use` for the code → design path.
- figma:figma-use: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `use_figma` tool call. NEVER call `use_figma` directly without loading this skill first. Skipping it causes common, hard-to-debug failures. Trigger whenever the user wants to perform a write action or a unique read action that requires JavaScript execution in the Figma file context — e.g. create/edit/delete nodes, set up variables or tokens, build components and variants, modify auto-layout or fills, bind variables to properties, or inspect file structure programmatically.
- figma:figma-use-figjam: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the FigJam context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.
- figma:figma-use-motion: Motion / animation context for the `use_figma` MCP tool — animating Figma nodes via manual keyframes, animation styles, easing, and timeline duration. Load alongside figma-use whenever a task involves adding, editing, or inspecting animation on a node.
- figma:figma-use-slides: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the Slides context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.

Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.

<result>Confirmed: there's no `frontend/services` or `frontend/api` directory — the frontend has no API client abstraction layer at all. Every fetch call is inlined directly with raw `fetch()` in the page component itself (`page.tsx`), all typed as `any`. No dedicated `Lesson`/`LessonSummary` TS interface exists anywhere in the codebase.

## Report

**Architecture**: Monorepo — `frontend/` (Next.js App Router) + `src/FutureClassroom.Api` (.NET/EF Core backend), `src/FutureClassroom.Core` (data layer). No `services/`/`api/` client abstraction in the frontend; every page does raw `fetch()` inline. No shared TS `Lesson` type/interface exists — all lesson data is typed `any`.

**1. Where `lessons` is fetched/rendered**
`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/page.tsx`
- Fetch: lines 74-99, `fetchLessons()` calls `GET {basePath}/api/courses/{courseKey}/lessons`, sets `courseDetail` state via `formatCourseDetail()` (lines 43-65).
- `lessons` array pulled at line 108: `const lessons = courseDetail?.lessons || [];`, sorted at 109-119.
- Rendered as `<tr>` rows in a `<table>`, lines 345-409 (no separate `LessonCard`/`LessonListItem` component — it's inlined in the page).
- Fields used per lesson: `lesson_id`, `week_number`, `lesson_date`, `topic`, `status` (`completed`/`analyzing`/`error`/other), `errorText`, `processText`, `isNew`.
- Backend DTO (`src/FutureClassroom.Api/Models/CourseLessonsResponse.cs:15-22`):
```csharp
public record LessonSummaryDto(
    string LessonId, int WeekNumber, string LessonDate,
    string? Topic, string Status, string? LastUpdatedAt);
```

**2. Lesson detail page fetch**
`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx`:
- `fetchLessonDetail()` (lines 65-106) calls `GET {basePath}/api/lessons/{lessonId}` directly — independent of the `lessons` list endpoint. This is the actual AI-analysis data source (backend: `LessonService.GetLessonAsync`, reads from `AiResults`/`AiWindows`/`AiWindowSeats` tables).
- Separately, `fetchCourseDetail()` (lines 114-144) re-fetches `/api/courses/{courseKey}/lessons` just to look up `topic`/`status`/`lesson_date` metadata for display — meaning the detail page depends on the same possibly-empty `lessons` array for metadata (course name, topic, date), even though the AI result itself comes from `/lessons/{lessonId}` independently.

**3. Root cause / existing "list analysis sessions" API**
Backend `CourseService.GetCourseLessonsAsync` (`src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/CourseService.cs:60-114`) queries `db.Lessons` (a schedule-metadata table) first, then left-joins `db.AiResults` by `LessonId`. **If no row exists in `db.Lessons` for that course/week, the lesson is silently excluded — even though `db.AiResults` has real analysis data for that `lesson_id`.** This is exactly the empty-array bug scenario described.

The closest existing "list available analysis sessions independent of Lessons metadata" endpoint is `GET /lessons/latest` (`LessonsEndpoints.cs:21-25`, backed by `LessonService.GetLatestLessonsAsync`, `LessonService.cs:70-123`). It queries `db.AiResults` directly (`WHERE IsScreenshotGenerated`, ordered by `GeneratedAt`/`CreatedAt`), joins `Courses` for display metadata, and is **not** filtered/gated by `db.Lessons`. However it's a global "latest N across all courses" feed (used by `frontend/app/home/page.tsx:144`), not scoped/paginated per courseKey — there's no existing `GET /courses/{courseKey}/analysis-sessions`-style endpoint that lists all `AiResults` for one course regardless of `Lessons` table state.

**4. Lesson list item UI structure**
No `LessonCard`/`LessonListItem` component exists — the row is inlined directly in `page.tsx`'s JSX (a `<tr>`, lines 345-409), driven purely by `any`-typed lesson objects and a local `StatusContent` helper component (lines 452-493) for the status badge. Adding a fallback single-item render when `lessons` is empty would require either (a) extracting this `<tr>` block into a reusable component and feeding it synthetic data derived from a `lessonKey` (e.g., parsed from `/lessons/latest` or a new per-course analysis-sessions endpoint), or (b) adding client-side logic to call `/api/lessons/{lessonKey}` directly when `lessons` is empty but a known lessonKey pattern exists. Since there's no backend endpoint that lists all `AiResults`/analysis dates for one specific `courseKey`, a proper fix likely needs a new backend endpoint (mirroring `GetLatestLessonsAsync` but filtered by `CourseKey` and not gated by the `Lessons` table) rather than a frontend-only workaround.</result>

可行,而且根源已經找到,程式碼證實了你的推測。

**根因**(`CourseService.cs:60-114` `GetCourseLessonsAsync`):查詢是從 `db.Lessons`(課程進度表metadata)出發、再 LEFT JOIN `db.AiResults`。只要 `Lessons` 表對這門課沒有任何一列,就算 `AiResults` 裡真的有分析資料,也完全不會被吐出來——這正是氣候變遷課程遇到的狀況。

**好消息**:已經有類似邏輯可以參考。`GET /lessons/latest`(`LessonService.GetLatestLessonsAsync`)是直接查 `db.AiResults`,不受 `Lessons` 表限制,只是它目前是「跨所有課程」的全域清單,沒有依 `courseKey` 過濾的版本。也就是說**沒有現成的「單一課程的分析紀錄清單」API**,需要新增一個小端點。

**建議做法**:與其讓前端在 `lessons` 為空時額外打一次 API、自己組 fallback 資料(容易散落成兩套邏輯、toast 觸發時機不好抓),我會建議把 fallback 邏輯收在後端 `GetCourseLessonsAsync` 裡——當 `db.Lessons` 對該課程查無資料時,改為直接查 `db.AiResults`(仿造 `GetLatestLessonsAsync` 的寫法,加上 `CourseKey` 過濾),回傳的 `LessonSummaryDto` 把 `WeekNumber`/`Topic` 留空或給一個標記欄位(例如 `IsFallback: true`)。這樣前端維持同一支 API、同一個資料形狀,只需要:
1. 在列表 row 渲染時,若 `week_number`/`topic` 為空就不顯示週次與進度文字(`page.tsx:345-409` 那段 `<tr>`,目前沒有抽成獨立元件,改動範圍不大)。
2. 依 `IsFallback` 決定要不要顯示提示 tooltip/toast。

主要取捨:後端做 fallback 比較乾淨但需要動 C# 後端(EF Core query + DTO 加欄位);純前端做則不用碰後端,但要多一次 fetch、且「空清單判斷+第二次請求+toast」邏輯會散在前端頁面裡,較難維護。你傾向哪一種?或想先看看後端這段程式碼再決定?

**1. 頭部提示(`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/page.tsx`)**
在課程名稱標題旁加了一個「?」提示圖示(沿用現有的 `Tooltip` 元件,專案裡沒有 toast 套件,所以沒有另外引入新依賴),只在 `is_fallback_schedule` 為 true 時顯示,hover 文字:「課程網尚未提供本課程的詳細週次進度,以下僅顯示已有課堂分析結果的日期。」`npx tsc --noEmit` 確認沒有新增型別錯誤(唯一的錯誤是專案本來就有、跟這次改動無關的 `jspdf` 缺型別問題)。

**2. 後端邏輯驗證**
沒有直接連測試環境的資料庫(`docker-compose.test.yml` 裡的連線字串是共用基礎設施,不確定我這邊網路能不能連到,而且連上去也只是驗證舊版程式碼、不會反映我改的邏輯),改用 EF Core InMemory 建一個獨立的驗證專案,模擬完全對應回報情境的資料組合,結果符合預期(細節見上方)。

**變更檔案**:
- `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Models/CourseLessonsResponse.cs` — 加 `IsFallbackSchedule` 欄位
- `src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/CourseService.cs` — fallback 查詢邏輯
- `frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/page.tsx` — 頭部提示圖示

Also check `RecordDate` and `Week` fields on the same entity, and `LessonId` (format `{courseKey}_{week}_{MMdd}`).

Context: I just shipped a fix where `CourseService.GetCourseLessonsAsync` (src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/CourseService.cs) falls back to querying `db.AiResults.Where(r => r.CourseKey == courseKey && r.LessonDate != null)` when a course has zero rows in `db.Lessons` (the school never sent schedule metadata for it). Testing on the real test environment revealed:

1. 1. Find the code path that creates/upserts `AiResult` rows (likely an ingestion endpoint or job — search for `AiResults.Add`, `AiResults.Update`, or similar upsert logic, in src/FutureClassroom.Api and src/FutureClassroom.Job). 兩支 API 直接打測試環境驗證,兩個症狀原因都抓到了,而且是兩個獨立的問題:

**Bug A(我的 fallback 邏輯造成,可修)**:AI 推送分析結果時,`lesson_date`/`record_date` 是 AI 端 payload 裡選填的欄位——5/27 那筆兩個都是空字串(DB裡是 null),所以被我 `LessonDate != null` 的過濾條件排除掉了;應用力學2那筆也是同樣狀況,兩個欄位都是空的,所以整份列表變成空的。但 `generated_at` 這個欄位是後端在寫入時*強制*用它去組 `LessonId`(`CourseHelper.BuildLessonId(courseKey, week, meta.GeneratedAt!.ToDateTime())`,用了 null-forgiving operator),代表這欄位在所有成功寫入的紀錄裡都一定有值,而且驗證下來三筆資料的 `generated_at` 日期都跟 `LessonId` 裡編碼的日期完全一致。我要把 fallback 邏輯改成優先用 `LessonDate`,沒有的話退回用 `GeneratedAt`,而不是直接排除。

**Bug B(不是我這次改的,屬於既有的背景 Job 問題,先回報不動手)**:6/10 那筆顯示「資料分析中」,但其實 `result.groups` 裡已經有完整的投入程度數據——`IsScreenshotGenerated` 只是代表縮圖是否已產生(`VideoScreenshot.cs` job 負責),跟分析數據是否完成是兩回事。但這個 job 的候選查詢是 `UpdatedAt >= now-1天`,只處理最近24小時內更新過的紀錄,超過這個窗口的紀錄即使還沒產生縮圖也永遠不會再被處理,狀態就卡死在「分析中」。這個影響範圍是全系統(不只是 fallback 課程),我先不動它,等你決定要不要另外處理。

不是髒資料,是兩個真實邏輯 bug,已經用測試環境的真實 API 回應驗證出根因:

- 應用力學2:6/1(第15週)會顯示

**還沒修(建議另外處理,影響範圍更大)**:6/10 那筆會一直顯示「資料分析中」,但其實投入程度數據已經算完了。原因是「產生縮圖」跟「投入程度分析」是兩件事,縮圖是由一個背景 Job(`VideoScreenshot.cs`)負責,但這個 Job 只處理「最近24小時內更新過」的紀錄,超過這個窗口就永遠不會再被撿到,狀態卡死在「分析中」。這不是只有 fallback 課程才有的問題,是全系統的既有 bug,要不要現在一起處理?

# 「近期查看」改用 localStorage 記錄實際瀏覽紀錄

## Context

首頁「近期查看」區塊目前是寫死的假資料(`frontend/app/home/page.tsx` 的 `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES`,標注 `// TODO: 從 API 獲取最近查看過的課程`),缺少 `course_key` 欄位導致點擊連結會變成 `/course/undefined/lesson/...`(已於前一輪修補,但仍是假資料)。

目前系統尚未串接 SSO 登入,無法依「使用者身份」在後端記錄瀏覽紀錄。這次先用最簡單、不依賴登入身份的方式:**在瀏覽器 localStorage 記錄「這台瀏覽器最近進入過哪些課堂 detail 頁、什麼時間進入的」**,首頁只取最近 4 筆依時間排序顯示。之後若串接 SSO,可以再把這個 client-side 記錄機制升級成呼叫後端 API(屆時再依使用者身份做真正的伺服器端記錄)。

## 現況引用點

- 寫入時機:`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx` — 使用者進入課堂 detail 頁時,`fetchLessonDetail`(`GET /api/lessons/{lessonId}`,約 65-106 行)取得 `course_id`、`class_section`、`generated_at`;`fetchCourseDetail`(`GET /api/courses/{courseKey}/lessons`,約 114-144 行)取得 `course_name`。兩者合併進 `lessonDetail.metadata`。目前 `fetchCourseDetail` 沒有把 `course_schedule` 一併存進 metadata,需要補上,才能組出「一, 7-8」這種時段標籤。
- 讀取/顯示:`frontend/app/home/page.tsx` 的 `<DataCard title="近期查看" data={RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES} hasLastCheckedAt sortByField="last_checked_at" sortOrder="desc" />`(約 246-252 行)。
- 渲染邏輯:`frontend/components/DataCard.tsx` — 連結用 `item.course_key`/`item.lesson_id` 組成(107 行);畫面上會用到的欄位是 `name`、`generated_at`(顯示日期標籤)、`course_id`、`class`、`schedule`、`last_checked_at`(相對時間,`hasLastCheckedAt` 開啟時顯示,107-161 行的 `formatRelativeTime` 用 `dateString.replace(/-/g, "/")` 再 `new Date()` 解析,所以時間字串要維持 `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"` 這種可被安全轉換的格式,不能用 ISO 字串,否則 replace 後格式會壞掉)。
- 全域搜尋確認過:專案裡目前完全沒有 `localStorage` 相關程式碼,是全新的機制,沒有既有 hook 可以重用。

## 實作內容

### 1. 新增 `frontend/utils/recentlyViewed.ts`

一個小型 client-only 工具模組:

```ts
export interface RecentlyViewedLesson {
  course_key: string;
  course_id: string;
  class: string;
  schedule: string;
  name: string;
  lesson_id: string;
  generated_at: string | null;
  last_checked_at: string; // "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"，本機時間
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "fc_recently_viewed_lessons";
const MAX_STORED = 20; // 儲存上限（緩衝用，避免無限成長；顯示時再取前 N 筆）

export function recordRecentlyViewedLesson(
  entry: Omit<RecentlyViewedLesson, "last_checked_at">,
): void { ... }

export function getRecentlyViewedLessons(limit = 4): RecentlyViewedLesson[] { ... }
```

- `recordRecentlyViewedLesson`:讀出現有清單 → 移除同 `lesson_id` 的舊紀錄(避免同一堂課重複進入時出現重複列)→ 把新紀錄(附上此刻的 `last_checked_at`)放到最前面 → 裁到 `MAX_STORED` 筆 → 寫回 localStorage。
- `getRecentlyViewedLessons`:讀取、`JSON.parse`、依 `last_checked_at` 由新到舊排序、取前 `limit` 筆。
- 兩個函式都包 `try/catch` 並在開頭判斷 `typeof window === "undefined"` 直接回傳 `[]`/不動作,避免 SSR 或 localStorage 被封鎖(隱私模式)時噴錯;JSON 解析失敗時視為空清單,不讓壞資料把頁面弄掛。

### 2. 修改 `frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx`

- `fetchCourseDetail`(114-144 行)的 metadata 合併多加一個欄位:`course_schedule: resBody.course_schedule`(原始陣列,沿用首頁「最新分析」已經在用的 `formatCourseSchedule` 工具去格式化)。
- 新增一個 `useEffect`,依賴 `courseKey`、`lessonId`、`lessonDetail?.metadata?.course_name`、`lessonDetail?.metadata?.generated_at`(這兩個欄位分別來自兩支不同 API,都有值才代表兩邊都抓完整了),在條件滿足時呼叫一次 `recordRecentlyViewedLesson({ course_key: courseKey, lesson_id: lessonId, course_id: metadata.course_id, class: metadata.class_section, schedule: formatCourseSchedule(metadata.course_schedule), name: metadata.course_name, generated_at: metadata.generated_at })`。
- 呼叫多次(例如 React strict mode 在 dev 環境下重複觸發 effect)不會造成重複列,因為工具函式內部會先移除同 `lesson_id` 的舊紀錄再插入。

### 3. 修改 `frontend/app/home/page.tsx`

- 移除 `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES` 假資料陣列與其 TODO 註解。
- 新增 `const [recentlyViewedLessons, setRecentlyViewedLessons] = useState<RecentlyViewedLesson[]>([])`,搭配 `useEffect(() => setRecentlyViewedLessons(getRecentlyViewedLessons(4)), [])` 在 client端 mount 時讀取。
- `<DataCard title="近期查看" data={recentlyViewedLessons} .../>` 其餘 props(`hasLastCheckedAt`、`sortByField="last_checked_at"`、`sortOrder="desc"`)維持不變。

## 已知限制(先讓使用者知情，不在這次處理)

- 這是「這台瀏覽器/裝置」的紀錄,不是「這個使用者」的紀錄——換瀏覽器、清 localStorage、換裝置都會看到空清單或不同紀錄。等 SSO 串接後應該改成後端記錄。
- 只記錄「有進入過 detail 頁」,不代表該堂課分析已完成。

## 驗證方式

1. `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`,確認除了既有的 `jspdf` 型別錯誤外沒有新增錯誤。
2. `npm run dev` 本機啟動,瀏覽器開兩個不同課程的 lesson detail 頁(例如氣候變遷對策 5/27、應用力學2 6/1),再回首頁確認「近期查看」出現這兩筆、連結可以正確導回對應課程/課堂、且沒有 `undefined`。
3. 用瀏覽器 DevTools 檢查 `localStorage.getItem("fc_recently_viewed_lessons")` 內容格式正確、重複進入同一堂課不會產生重複列。
4. 確認「所有課程」連結、「最新分析」區塊行為不受影響。

首頁「近期查看」區塊目前是寫死的假資料(`frontend/app/home/page.tsx` 的 `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES`,標注 `// TODO: 從 API 獲取最近查看過的課程`),缺少 `course_key` 欄位導致點擊連結會變成 `/course/undefined/lesson/...`(已於前一輪修補,但仍是假資料)。

目前系統尚未串接 SSO 登入,無法依「使用者身份」在後端記錄瀏覽紀錄。這次先用最簡單、不依賴登入身份的方式:**在瀏覽器 localStorage 記錄「這台瀏覽器最近進入過哪些課堂 detail 頁、什麼時間進入的」**,首頁只取最近 4 筆依時間排序顯示。之後若串接 SSO,可以再把這個 client-side 記錄機制升級成呼叫後端 API(屆時再依使用者身份做真正的伺服器端記錄)。

## 現況引用點

- 寫入時機:`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx` — 使用者進入課堂 detail 頁時,`fetchLessonDetail`(`GET /api/lessons/{lessonId}`,約 65-106 行)取得 `course_id`、`class_section`、`generated_at`;`fetchCourseDetail`(`GET /api/courses/{courseKey}/lessons`,約 114-144 行)取得 `course_name`。兩者合併進 `lessonDetail.metadata`。目前 `fetchCourseDetail` 沒有把 `course_schedule` 一併存進 metadata,需要補上,才能組出「一, 7-8」這種時段標籤。
- 讀取/顯示:`frontend/app/home/page.tsx` 的 `<DataCard title="近期查看" data={RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES} hasLastCheckedAt sortByField="last_checked_at" sortOrder="desc" />`(約 246-252 行)。
- 渲染邏輯:`frontend/components/DataCard.tsx` — 連結用 `item.course_key`/`item.lesson_id` 組成(107 行);畫面上會用到的欄位是 `name`、`generated_at`(顯示日期標籤)、`course_id`、`class`、`schedule`、`last_checked_at`(相對時間,`hasLastCheckedAt` 開啟時顯示,107-161 行的 `formatRelativeTime` 用 `dateString.replace(/-/g, "/")` 再 `new Date()` 解析,所以時間字串要維持 `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"` 這種可被安全轉換的格式,不能用 ISO 字串,否則 replace 後格式會壞掉)。
- 全域搜尋確認過:專案裡目前完全沒有 `localStorage` 相關程式碼,是全新的機制,沒有既有 hook 可以重用。

## 實作內容

### 1. 新增 `frontend/utils/recentlyViewed.ts`

一個小型 client-only 工具模組:

```ts
export interface RecentlyViewedLesson {
  course_key: string;
  course_id: string;
  class: string;
  schedule: string;
  name: string;
  lesson_id: string;
  generated_at: string | null;
  last_checked_at: string; // "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"，本機時間
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "fc_recently_viewed_lessons";
const MAX_STORED = 20; // 儲存上限（緩衝用，避免無限成長；顯示時再取前 N 筆）

export function recordRecentlyViewedLesson(
  entry: Omit<RecentlyViewedLesson, "last_checked_at">,
): void { ... }

export function getRecentlyViewedLessons(limit = 4): RecentlyViewedLesson[] { ... }
```

- `recordRecentlyViewedLesson`:讀出現有清單 → 移除同 `lesson_id` 的舊紀錄(避免同一堂課重複進入時出現重複列)→ 把新紀錄(附上此刻的 `last_checked_at`)放到最前面 → 裁到 `MAX_STORED` 筆 → 寫回 localStorage。
- `getRecentlyViewedLessons`:讀取、`JSON.parse`、依 `last_checked_at` 由新到舊排序、取前 `limit` 筆。
- 兩個函式都包 `try/catch` 並在開頭判斷 `typeof window === "undefined"` 直接回傳 `[]`/不動作,避免 SSR 或 localStorage 被封鎖(隱私模式)時噴錯;JSON 解析失敗時視為空清單,不讓壞資料把頁面弄掛。

### 2. 修改 `frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx`

- `fetchCourseDetail`(114-144 行)的 metadata 合併多加一個欄位:`course_schedule: resBody.course_schedule`(原始陣列,沿用首頁「最新分析」已經在用的 `formatCourseSchedule` 工具去格式化)。
- 新增一個 `useEffect`,依賴 `courseKey`、`lessonId`、`lessonDetail?.metadata?.course_name`、`lessonDetail?.metadata?.generated_at`(這兩個欄位分別來自兩支不同 API,都有值才代表兩邊都抓完整了),在條件滿足時呼叫一次 `recordRecentlyViewedLesson({ course_key: courseKey, lesson_id: lessonId, course_id: metadata.course_id, class: metadata.class_section, schedule: formatCourseSchedule(metadata.course_schedule), name: metadata.course_name, generated_at: metadata.generated_at })`。
- 呼叫多次(例如 React strict mode 在 dev 環境下重複觸發 effect)不會造成重複列,因為工具函式內部會先移除同 `lesson_id` 的舊紀錄再插入。

### 3. 修改 `frontend/app/home/page.tsx`

- 移除 `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES` 假資料陣列與其 TODO 註解。
- 新增 `const [recentlyViewedLessons, setRecentlyViewedLessons] = useState<RecentlyViewedLesson[]>([])`,搭配 `useEffect(() => setRecentlyViewedLessons(getRecentlyViewedLessons(4)), [])` 在 client端 mount 時讀取。
- `<DataCard title="近期查看" data={recentlyViewedLessons} .../>` 其餘 props(`hasLastCheckedAt`、`sortByField="last_checked_at"`、`sortOrder="desc"`)維持不變。

## 已知限制(先讓使用者知情，不在這次處理)

- 這是「這台瀏覽器/裝置」的紀錄,不是「這個使用者」的紀錄——換瀏覽器、清 localStorage、換裝置都會看到空清單或不同紀錄。等 SSO 串接後應該改成後端記錄。
- 只記錄「有進入過 detail 頁」,不代表該堂課分析已完成。

## 驗證方式

1. `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`,確認除了既有的 `jspdf` 型別錯誤外沒有新增錯誤。
2. `npm run dev` 本機啟動,瀏覽器開兩個不同課程的 lesson detail 頁(例如氣候變遷對策 5/27、應用力學2 6/1),再回首頁確認「近期查看」出現這兩筆、連結可以正確導回對應課程/課堂、且沒有 `undefined`。
3. 用瀏覽器 DevTools 檢查 `localStorage.getItem("fc_recently_viewed_lessons")` 內容格式正確、重複進入同一堂課不會產生重複列。
4. 確認「所有課程」連結、「最新分析」區塊行為不受影響。

FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
ARG NEXT_BASE_PATH=/futureclassroom
ENV NEXT_BASE_PATH=$NEXT_BASE_PATH
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=$NEXT_BASE_PATH
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=/api/proxy

WORKDIR /app
ENV TZ=Asia/Taipei
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY --from=builder /app/.next/standalone ./

ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0"
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

查完了,結論很乾淨:**是後端的問題,不是 AI 端資料的問題(對應到我上次講的 (b),不是 (a))。**

## 驗證方式與證據

寫了一段程式,把 `ai-result-source/` 底下全部 6 個 AI 原始推送檔案(所有 window、所有小組 T1-T6、以及 class_average)都跑過一次,分兩項檢查:

1. **每個座位自己的4個投入程度分類值是否真的加總=1.0**
   結果:**全部 15,699 筆座位資料,無一例外,加總都是 1.0**(誤差在浮點數容許範圍內)。代表 AI 端推送的原始資料是乾淨、正規化過的,不是資料品質問題。

2. **套用後端目前的四捨五入修正演算法(`FractionsToPercentages`)後,結果是否還是有加總≠100的情況**
   結果:**6 個檔案裡有5個檔案、總共 64 次window/小組組合,加總變成101**,而且這64次全部符合同一個模式:
   - 超出的量**永遠剛好是 +1**(從沒出現過+2或更多)
   - 觸發的當下,**第4個分類(engagement level "3",最高投入程度)原始四捨五入值永遠剛好是 0**

## 所以確切的成因是

`FractionsToPercentages`(`LessonService.cs:188-194`)四個分類各自獨立四捨五入後,總和本來就可能因為捨入誤差變成101(這是四個數字分別四捨五入的常見副作用),原本設計是要把這1的誤差補到「最後一個分類(level 3)」上去抵銷。但 level 3 通常是最少見的「最高投入程度」分類,原始值常常本來就是0,已經沒有再往下扣的空間,`Math.Max(0, ...)` 夾住之後這個誤差就補不回去,101就這樣直接漏出去給前端了。

這純粹是後端這支修正函式的邏輯瑕疵(該補的誤差找不到地方放,而不是隨便丟掉),跟 AI 端推送的資料完全無關,AI端資料是乾淨的。要不要我接著修?(思路大概是:誤差應該補到「原始四捨五入值最大」或「有空間可以吸收」的分類,而不是固定寫死補最後一個)

import json, glob, math

def to_pcts_largest_remainder(fractions):
    raw = [f*100 for f in fractions]
    pcts = [math.floor(v) for v in raw]
    deficit = 100 - sum(pcts)
    order = sorted(range(len(raw)), key=lambda i: raw[i]-pcts[i], reverse=True)
    for i in range(deficit):
        pcts[order[i]] += 1
    return pcts

def analyze(path):
    with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    windows = data['windows']
    bad = []
    for w in windows:
        groups = [k for k in w.keys() if k.startswith('T')]
        entries = [(g, w[g]) for g in groups] + [('class', {'__CLASS__': w['class_average']})]

            for s, vals in seats.items():
                for lvl in ['0','1','2','3']:
                    sum4[int(lvl)] += vals.get(lvl, 0.0)
            fractions = [v/n for v in sum4]
            pcts = to_pcts_largest_remainder(fractions)
            if sum(pcts) != 100:

content.text:
「資料分析中」的判斷邏輯,從畫面往下追是這樣一條鏈:

## 1. 前端顯示

`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/page.tsx`
- `formatCourseDetail`:`status === "analyzing"` 時,`processText` 預設文字就是「資料分析中」。
- `StatusContent` 元件:`status === "analyzing"` 就渲染黃色的「資料分析中」樣式(旁邊那個轉圈圈圖示)。

也就是說,前端**完全只看後端回傳的 `status` 欄位字串**,不知道背後實際進度。

## 2. 後端怎麼算出 `status`

`src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/CourseService.cs`(不管是有 `Lessons` 排課資料的正常路徑,還是我們之前修的 fallback 路徑,邏輯都一樣):

```csharp
status = ai.IsScreenshotGenerated ? LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed : LessonEnum.LessonStatus.analyzing;
```

**只要 `AiResult.IsScreenshotGenerated == false`,狀態就一律是「analyzing」**——跟這堂課的投入程度分析(`AiWindows`/`AiWindowSeats`,也就是上面那個折線圖用的資料)是否已經算完、有沒有資料,完全無關。`IsScreenshotGenerated` 顧名思義只代表「影片縮圖有沒有產生」。

## 3. `IsScreenshotGenerated` 什麼時候會變 true

`src/FutureClassroom.Job/Jobs/Implement/VideoScreenshot.cs`
- 第70行,這個背景 Job 每次執行時,候選清單是:
  ```csharp
  db.AiResults.Where(x => !x.IsScreenshotGenerated && x.UpdatedAt >= DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1))
  ```
  **只處理「還沒產生縮圖」且「最近24小時內有更新過」的紀錄。**
- 對每筆候選資料,依序:找對應影片檔 → 從 MinIO 下載 → 用 ffmpeg 產生縮圖 → 上傳到 S3 → 全部成功才把 `IsScreenshotGenerated` 設成 `true`(第126行)。
- 中間任何一步失敗(例如影片檔案在 MinIO 上根本找不到、ffmpeg 出錯),就只記 log,這筆紀錄的 `IsScreenshotGenerated` 維持 `false`,不會重試。

## 關鍵問題點

一旦這筆 `AiResult` 的 `UpdatedAt` 超過24小時還沒成功產生縮圖,它就永遠不會再被這個 Job 撿到(第70行的時間窗把它排除在候選清單外),`IsScreenshotGenerated` 就永久卡在 `false`——但前端看到的字串跟「真的正在處理中」是同一個「資料分析中」,無法分辨「還在排隊」跟「已經被放棄、永遠不會好」。這跟截圖那筆 6/10 資料吻合:它的投入程度數據其實已經有(前面確認過 `result.groups` 有完整資料),純粹是縮圖流程沒在24小時內跑完,狀態就卡死了。

這就是目前的判斷邏輯,先讓你評估要不要處理、怎麼處理(例如:狀態判斷邏輯改成看是否有 `AiWindows`/`AiWindowSeats` 資料而不是看縮圖旗標、或是把 Job 的24小時視窗拿掉/改成重試機制)。

<result>I have all the information needed. Here's the report.

## 1. `frontend/components/VideoPlayer.tsx`

**Filmstrip (bottom):** Driven by `lessonId` prop (not a direct thumbnail-list prop). On `handleLoadedMetadata` (video's `loadedmetadata` event, line 214-228), it calls `fetchThumbnails(duration)` (line 158-211), which fetches `${basePath}/api/image/thumb/${lessonId}/${minuteIndex}` for each 360-second interval (`THUMB_INTERVAL_SEC = 360`, line 29), turning each response into a blob URL, stored in `thumbnails` state (line 82). If any fetch fails, it falls back to `mockThumbnailMapping[lessonId]` static JPEG paths (lines 186-206). Thumbnails render at lines 580-609 as `<img src={src}>` inside the filmstrip div.

**Placeholder state:** There IS an existing empty/placeholder state, but it's gated by `status === "analyzing"` (not by thumbnail-fetch failure per se): `showPlaceholderStrip` (lines 105-110) is true when `status === "analyzing" && thumbnails.length === 0 && (!hasVideoSource || thumbnailFetchSettled)`. When true, blue gradient placeholder tiles (`PLACEHOLDER_COLORS`, lines 34-45) render instead of thumbnails (lines 559-578, and `previewContent` lines 496-502).

**"No recording" empty state:** When `status === "pending"` (lines 512-518), the whole component short-circuits to a simple centered message: `<p className="body-2-reg text-gray-70">尚無錄播內容</p>` inside a `<section className="h-[214px] bg-[rgba(6,45,65,0.1)] rounded-[12px] flex items-center justify-center">`. **This "尚無錄播內容" text already exists** — currently only shown for `status === "pending"`, not for the "screenshots not yet generated" case.

**Important gap:** If `status` is anything other than `"pending"`/`"analyzing"` (e.g., `"completed"`) but thumbnails simply fail to load and there's no mock fallback, thumbnails stays `[]` and the filmstrip silently renders empty (no broken `<img>` icons since nothing is pushed to state — but also no empty-state message). There's currently **no conditional handling tied to `is_screenshot_generated`** anywhere in this file.

**`previewContainer`/`keyframePreviewEl` rendering:** Lines 831-838, via `createPortal`. `previewContent` (computed at lines 496-509) is either the placeholder color block, the active thumbnail `<img>`, or `null` (no thumbnail available and not in placeholder mode). The portal only renders `if (previewContainer && previewContent)` — so if `previewContent` is `null`, nothing is portaled into `keyframePreviewEl`, leaving it visually empty (whatever background the parent div has, no explicit empty-state message from VideoPlayer itself for this case).

## 2. `frontend/components/EngagementChart.tsx`

Condition (line 197-199):
```tsx
const isPending = status === "pending";
const isAnalyzing = status === "isAnalyzing";
const isCompleted = !isPending && !isAnalyzing;
```
Empty-state JSX (lines 1028-1048), rendered when `!isCompleted`:
```tsx
{!isCompleted && (
  <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none z-20">
    <div className="text-center px-4">
      <p className="title-2 text-gray-90 mb-2">
        {isPending ? "尚未開始分析" : isAnalyzing ? "資料分析中" : "資料分析失敗"}
      </p>
      <p className="body-2-reg text-gray-70">
        {isPending
          ? "系統將於互動資料收集完成後開始分析"
          : isAnalyzing
            ? "系統將於課堂結束後數小時完成分析，完成後將於通知中心提醒您"
            : "請洽詢教務處資訊組 (02) 33662388 #610"}
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
)}
```

## 3. `is_screenshot_generated` usage search

Grepped case-insensitively (camelCase and snake_case) across `frontend/` — **zero matches**. The field is not read/used anywhere on the frontend currently. The lesson detail page fetches `GET /api/lessons/{lessonId}` (page.tsx line 69) into `lessonDetail`, but nothing extracts or passes `is_screenshot_generated`/`isScreenshotGenerated` from `lessonDetail.metadata` to `VideoPlayer` or elsewhere — it's currently ignored entirely.

Exact current lines 285-303:
```tsx

    ref={videoPlayerRef}
    videoSrc={videoUrl}
```

`status` passed in is `lessonDetail?.metadata?.status` — `is_screenshot_generated` is available at `lessonDetail?.metadata?.is_screenshot_generated` but is not currently read or passed anywhere here.</result>

## 完成,兩項改動都做完並驗證過

**1. 課程列表「資料分析中」判斷邏輯(`src/FutureClassroom.Api/Services/CourseService.cs`)**

`GetCourseLessonsAsync` 的正常路徑跟 fallback 路徑,都把判斷依據從 `AiResult.IsScreenshotGenerated`(縮圖是否產生)改成「`AiWindows` 是否有資料」(真正的分析結果是否存在)。用 EF Core InMemory 驗證過:
- 有分析資料但沒縮圖(6/10 那種情況)→ 現在正確顯示 `completed`(以前是 `analyzing`)
- 真的還沒有分析資料 → 維持 `analyzing`
- 有 `Lessons` 排課資料的正常課程路徑也套用同樣邏輯,一併驗證過

**2. Detail 頁影片縮圖列 + 右側單張預覽(`frontend/components/VideoPlayer.tsx` + `page.tsx`)**

- `VideoPlayer` 新增 `hasScreenshots` prop,從 `lessonDetail.metadata.is_screenshot_generated`(這欄位其實後端本來就有回傳,只是前端從沒用過)傳入。
- 原本只有 `status === "pending"` 才會整塊換成「尚無錄播內容」提示框(截圖2藍圈的樣式),現在改成 `status === "pending" || !hasScreenshots`,只要沒有縮圖就一律用同一套提示框,不再顯示播放器控制項/漸層色塊。
- 因為這個提示框是整個取代掉 `previewContainer` 的 portal 渲染邏輯,右側單張預覽區塊(`keyframePreviewEl`)自然就不會有任何內容被塞進去,符合截圖2藍叉「完全不顯示」的需求,不需要額外改動。

`dotnet build`、`tsc --noEmit` 都乾淨。沒有 commit,你要看過再自己 commit。

content.content:
1	using FutureClassroom.Api.Models;
2	using FutureClassroom.Core.Data;
3	using FutureClassroom.Core.Enumeration;
4	using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
5	using System.Text.Json;
6	
7	namespace FutureClassroom.Api.Services;
8	
9	public class CourseService(AppDbContext db)
10	{
11	    // Shown as the lesson topic when a course has no Lessons schedule metadata
12	    // and we fall back to listing raw AiResults instead.
13	    private const string NoScheduleTopicPlaceholder = "課程網無課程進度資訊";
14	
15	    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions _caseInsensitive = new()
16	    {
17	        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
18	        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower
19	    };
20	
21	    public async Task<CoursesResponse> GetCoursesAsync(string? semester)
22	    {
23	        var query = db.Courses.AsQueryable();
24	        if (semester is not null)
25	            query = query.Where(c => c.Semester == semester);
26	
27	        var rawCourses = await query
28	            .Select(c => new { c.CourseId, c.Name, c.Section, c.CourseKey, c.SchedulesJson, c.Semester })
29	            .ToListAsync();
30	
31	        var courseKeys = rawCourses.Select(c => c.CourseKey).ToList();
32	
33	        var lessonStats = await db.AiResults
34	            .Where(r => courseKeys.Contains(r.CourseKey))
35	            .GroupBy(r => r.CourseKey)
36	            .Select(g => new
37	            {
38	                CourseKey = g.Key,
39	                Total = g.Count(),
40	                Completed = g.Count(r => r.IsScreenshotGenerated)
41	            })
42	            .ToDictionaryAsync(x => x.CourseKey, x => x);
43	
44	        var semesters = rawCourses
45	            .GroupBy(c => c.Semester)
46	            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Key)
47	            .Select(g => new SemesterDto(
48	                g.Key,
49	                g.Select(c => new CourseDto(
50	                    CourseId: c.CourseId,
51	                    CourseName: c.Name,
52	                    CourseSection: c.Section ?? "",
53	                    CourseKey: c.CourseKey,
54	                    CourseSchedule: c.SchedulesJson is null
55	                        ? []
56	                        : JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<CourseScheduleDto>>(c.SchedulesJson, _caseInsensitive) ?? [],
57	                    TotalLessons: lessonStats.TryGetValue(c.CourseKey, out var s) ? s.Total : 0,
58	                    Completed: lessonStats.TryGetValue(c.CourseKey, out var s2) ? s2.Completed : 0
59	                )).ToList()
60	            ))
61	            .ToList();
62	
63	        return new CoursesResponse(semesters);
64	    }
65	
66	    public async Task<CourseLessonsResponse?> GetCourseLessonsAsync(string courseKey)
67	    {
68	        var course = await db.Courses
69	            .Where(c => c.CourseKey == courseKey)
70	            .FirstOrDefaultAsync()
71	            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Course not found: {courseKey}");
72	
73	        var rawLessons = await db.Lessons
74	            .Where(l => l.CourseKey == courseKey)
75	            .OrderBy(l => l.WeekNumber)
76	            .Select(l => new { l.LessonId, l.WeekNumber, l.LessonDate, l.Topic, l.UpdatedAt })
77	            .ToListAsync();
78	
79	        var isFallbackSchedule = rawLessons.Count == 0;
80	        List<LessonSummaryDto> lessons;
81	
82	        if (!isFallbackSchedule)
83	        {
84	            var lessonIds = rawLessons.Select(l => l.LessonId).ToList();
85	            var aiResults = await db.AiResults
86	                .Where(r => lessonIds.Contains(r.LessonId))
87	                .Select(r => new { r.LessonId, r.UpdatedAt })
88	                .ToDictionaryAsync(r => r.LessonId);
89	
90	            // "Completed" means the analysis result (AiWindows/AiWindowSeats) actually
91	            // exists — not whether a screenshot thumbnail happens to have been
92	            // generated yet (that's a separate, unrelated background job).
93	            var lessonIdsWithAnalysis = (await db.AiWindows
94	                .Where(w => lessonIds.Contains(w.LessonId))
95	                .Select(w => w.LessonId)
96	                .Distinct()
97	                .ToListAsync())
98	                .ToHashSet();
99	
100	            lessons = rawLessons.Select(l =>
101	            {
102	                var status = LessonEnum.LessonStatus.pending;
103	                string? lastUpdatedAt = null;
104	
105	                if (aiResults.TryGetValue(l.LessonId, out var ai))
106	                {
107	                    status = lessonIdsWithAnalysis.Contains(l.LessonId) ? LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed : LessonEnum.LessonStatus.analyzing;
108	                    lastUpdatedAt = status == LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed ? ai.UpdatedAt.ToString("o") : null;
109	                }
110	
111	                return new LessonSummaryDto(
112	                    LessonId: l.LessonId,
113	                    WeekNumber: l.WeekNumber,
114	                    LessonDate: l.LessonDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
115	                    Topic: l.Topic,
116	                    Status: status.ToString(),
117	                    LastUpdatedAt: lastUpdatedAt
118	                );
119	            }).ToList();
120	        }
121	        else
122	        {
123	            // The school's course website never sent us a Lessons schedule for this
124	            // course. Fall back to whatever AI analysis results already exist so the
125	            // list isn't empty. LessonDate/RecordDate are optional fields on the AI
126	            // push payload and are often blank, but GeneratedAt is always set — it's
127	            // what the ingestion endpoint uses to build LessonId in the first place
128	            // (see AiResultEndpoints) — so it's the reliable date source here. Rows
129	            // with neither are skipped rather than shown as a blank row.
130	            var fallbackResults = await db.AiResults
131	                .Where(r => r.CourseKey == courseKey && (r.LessonDate != null || r.GeneratedAt != null))
132	                .Select(r => new { r.LessonId, r.Week, r.LessonDate, r.GeneratedAt, r.UpdatedAt })
133	                .ToListAsync();
134	
135	            var fallbackLessonIds = fallbackResults.Select(r => r.LessonId).ToList();
136	            var fallbackLessonIdsWithAnalysis = (await db.AiWindows
137	                .Where(w => fallbackLessonIds.Contains(w.LessonId))
138	                .Select(w => w.LessonId)
139	                .Distinct()
140	                .ToListAsync())
141	                .ToHashSet();
142	
143	            lessons = fallbackResults
144	                .Select(r =>
145	                {
146	                    var status = fallbackLessonIdsWithAnalysis.Contains(r.LessonId) ? LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed : LessonEnum.LessonStatus.analyzing;
147	                    var lessonDate = r.LessonDate ?? DateOnly.FromDateTime(r.GeneratedAt!.Value);
148	
149	                    return new LessonSummaryDto(
150	                        LessonId: r.LessonId,
151	                        WeekNumber: int.TryParse(r.Week, out var week) ? week : 0,
152	                        LessonDate: lessonDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
153	                        Topic: NoScheduleTopicPlaceholder,
154	                        Status: status.ToString(),
155	                        LastUpdatedAt: status == LessonEnum.LessonStatus.completed ? r.UpdatedAt.ToString("o") : null
156	                    );
157	                })
158	                .OrderBy(l => l.LessonDate)
159	                .ToList();
160	        }
161	
162	        var schedules = course.SchedulesJson is null
163	            ? []
164	            : JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<CourseScheduleDto>>(course.SchedulesJson, _caseInsensitive) ?? [];
165	
166	        return new CourseLessonsResponse(
167	            CourseId: course.CourseId,
168	            CourseName: course.Name,
169	            CourseSection: course.Section ?? "",
170	            CourseKey: courseKey,
171	            CourseSchedule: schedules,
172	            MaxCapacity: course.TotalStudentQuota,
173	            EnrolledCount: 0,
174	            Lessons: lessons,
175	            IsFallbackSchedule: isFallbackSchedule
176	        );
177	    }
178	}

讀完了,這個設計稿對應的是首頁「近期查看」卡片在**沒有資料時**要顯示的空狀態(empty state)畫面。我的理解整理如下:

## 設計內容

- **容器**:白底圓角卡片(`rounded-24px`),跟現有「近期查看」/「最新分析」卡片是同一種容器。
- **標題列**:「近期查看」,左對齊,高度固定44px。
- **內容區**(垂直置中):
  1. 一張插畫(108×150px)——是一個藍色圓形吉祥物角色拿著書、旁邊有張紙飛出去的插圖,語意上代表「找不到資料/尚無紀錄」。
  2. 標題文字「尚無查看紀錄」(粗體、Gray/90)+ 副標「最近瀏覽過的課程會顯示在此」(灰色、Gray/70)。
  3. 一個藥丸形狀的深藍按鈕(Blue/70 #0B6E93、白字)「前往我的課程」。

## 對應到現有程式碼的判斷

這正好對應我之前做的「近期查看」localStorage 功能——目前 `frontend/components/DataCard.tsx` 完全沒有處理 `data` 是空陣列的情況,只會渲染出一片空白,沒有這個設計稿裡的插畫/文字/按鈕。

而且我查了一下,插畫的實作方式**不應該**照 Figma 原始輸出的10個疊圖層(Vector、hand、book、paper...)直接組——這個專案已經有現成的慣例:`frontend/components/LogOutDialog.tsx` 用同一套「插畫 + 標題 + 副標」排版,插畫是單一張攤平好的 SVG 檔(`/images/img_status-logout.svg`)。這個設計稿的插畫圖層命名是「Image/illustration/**img_status-no-matches**」,跟現有檔名規則(`img_status-logout.svg`)完全吻合,代表這是設計系統裡同一組「狀態插畫」,應該用同樣方式匯出成一張 `img_status-no-matches.svg` 放進 `public/images/`,而不是手刻10個 SVG 圖層拼接。
